Pre-reading discussion2–3 min

Which life would you choose—and why?

Choose one and give your reasons. You may also suggest a fourth kind of life of your own.

Which life would you choose?

This is a starting point for discussion. There is no right answer, and in real life the three may overlap.

查看标准答案
道德与法治 · 参考作答依据七年级上下册相关观点整理

问：怎样的一生才是值得的？请运用所学知识作答。

  1. 实现自我价值，勇于承担责任。通过自己的努力立足生活，在他人需要时主动关爱、承担责任，把个人理想同国家发展、民族复兴及人类命运联系起来。
  2. 充盈生命，在创造与贡献中实现生命价值。热爱学习、积极实践，拓展生活经历，主动联系他人、社会与自然；关切他人，在平凡的劳动与生活中为家庭和社会尽责。
  3. 正确对待挫折，增强生命的韧性。认识到挫折是成长中的一部分，面对失落、焦虑等感受及时调整，发掘自身的承受力、自我调节和自我修复能力。
  4. 正确对待情绪情感，丰富生命体验。合理调节情绪，认识负面情感也能丰富人生阅历，学会承受并将其转化为成长的助力。

很好，分点作答，得分点齐了。

教材也承认负面感受的意义。我们再多问一步：

如果难过没有让我“成长”，
它还值得被接纳吗？

Must sadness help us grow to deserve a place in our lives?

Keep your answer in mind as you read how the author understands happiness.

The question running through the text

More happiness,
or a fuller experience of life?

Back to the opening question

Sum up the author’s answer in one sentence, and find one line from the text to support it.

See a sample answer

The author argues for attending to and accepting all kinds of experience and living life fully, rather than treating the maximization of happiness as life’s goal.

“They are not enemies to overcome or data to be processed, but part of who we are.”

The text does not prove that happiness cannot be measured, and the ending offers no new numerical scale.

Happiness, quantified

Central questionMore happiness, or a fuller experience of life?

    The author’s answerWhat matters most is not how much happiness you can measure, but how fully you are able to inhabit your own experiences.

    Being fully alive.

    从阅读中带走什么

    关注内心 · 第 8–9 段

    觉察并接纳自己的感受，不必强迫自己时刻快乐。

    投入生活 · 第 9–10 段

    留意周围的世界，充分投入当下的日常体验。

    原文表达 · 可迁移使用

    attend to and accept whatever you’re experiencing
    notice your feelings; wish them away
    part of who we are
    the world around you
    inhabit your own experiences

    展开参考范文 40 words · 自拟

    First, I can attend to and accept my feelings. When I feel sad, I notice the sadness instead of wishing it away. Second, I can inhabit my own experiences by noticing the world around me on my way to school.
